title: Primitives
description: Shared scalar and geometry definitions reused by every Halo CAD contract schema. All lengths are millimetres (float64) as required by docs/PLAN.md 5.

schema_version.title: SchemaVersion
schema_version.description: Contract version of the document, `<major>.<minor>`. A consumer accepts a document only when the major component equals the major component it was built against; minor bumps are additive-only. See packages/schema/README.md.

ulid.title: Ulid
ulid.description: Crockford base32 ULID (26 characters, uppercase). Used for every identifier Halo CAD generates.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 digest of a file's bytes.

handle.title: DxfHandle
handle.description: DXF entity handle as written in the working DXF: uppercase hexadecimal, no leading `0x`, 1-16 digits. `(file, handle)` is the cross-parser key defined by ADR-0002.

space.title: Space
space.description: `MODEL` for model space, or `PAPER:<layout name>` for a paper-space layout.

text_hash.title: TextHash
text_hash.description: First 16 hex characters of `sha1(NFC(text))`, where `text` is the NFC-normalised string (for aggregates: the member strings sorted ascending by code point and joined with `\n`). Defined identically in stats.ts and stats.py so both parsers can be compared (ADR-0002 6).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in [0, 1]. 1.0 means read directly and unambiguously from the drawing.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset.

author.title: Author
author.description: Account name of the person who created the record.

point.title: Point
point.description: `[x, y]` or `[x, y, z]` in millimetres, working-DXF world coordinates.

points.title: Points
points.description: Ordered list of points in millimetres.

bbox.title: BBox
bbox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in millimetres. `min` and `max` must have the same arity.

transform.title: Transform
transform.description: Block reference placement. `matrix` is the optional row-major 4x4 equivalent; when both are present they must agree.

level_kind.title: LevelKind
level_kind.description: The four height fields kept separate by ADR-0003. `SL` structural level, `FL` finished floor level, `FLOOR_HEIGHT` storey height (SL to SL), `CH` ceiling height (level/finish table). Never equality-compare `CH` against the other three.

level_source.title: LevelSource
level_source.description: Which drawing or table a height value was read from. `LEVEL_TABLE` and `FINISH_SCHEDULE` are the sources that yield `CH`; `ELEVATION`, `SECTION` and `STRUCT_PLAN` yield `SL` and `FL` (ADR-0003). `CEILING_PLAN` also yields `CH`, only when the ceiling plan drawing itself labels a ceiling height (ADR-0003 addendum, 2026-09-03) -- it is the one source a `CH`<->`CH` consistency check may compare against `LEVEL_TABLE`/`FINISH_SCHEDULE` with `EQ` (`levels/consistency-check.schema.json`).

stable_key.title: StableKey
stable_key.description: Deterministic re-import key for a derived object: `<etype>:<layer>:<sha1 of the 1mm-grid geometry fingerprint>`. Survives handle renumbering across revisions (docs/PLAN.md 4).
